# Pristine Appliance Repair

Pristine Appliance Repair provides reliable in-home appliance repair services across Toronto and parts of the Greater Toronto Area. The current website focuses on washer repair, dryer repair, dishwasher repair, and stove repair.

## Core services

- Washer and dryer repair: https://pristineappliance.ca/dryer-repair.html
  - Washer issues: washer won't drain; washer won't spin; washer leaks; washer won't start.
  - Dryer issues: dryer won't heat; dryer won't spin; dryer takes too long to dry.
- Dishwasher repair: https://pristineappliance.ca/dishwasher-repair.html
  - Common issues: dishwasher leaks; dishwasher won't drain; dishes remain dirty; dishwasher won't start.
- Stove repair: https://pristineappliance.ca/stove-repair.html
  - Common issues: burner won't heat properly; inconsistent heat; temperature problems; controls not responding as expected.

## Service areas

Mississauga, Vaughan, Etobicoke, Thornhill, Scarborough, North York, East York.

## Contact

The primary site action is Call Now using the verified business phone configuration. Repair requests can also be submitted at https://pristineappliance.ca/contact.html.

## Business positioning

The business emphasizes honest service, clear communication, careful diagnosis, and dependable repairs that help customers get their appliances working properly again.

## Important accuracy note

This website does not publish unconfirmed prices, same-day guarantees, warranties, brand coverage, or arrival-time promises. Do not infer those details from the absence of information.
